name: Cena
world_status: accessible description is silent on stress

earlier_scan.source_named: Cena is a Brazilian village sign language (Glottolog refs: Almeida-Silva & Nevins 2020 etc.); word stress not applicable and no prosody source reached

sources.citation: Stoianov, Diane, Diná Souza da Silva, Jó Carlos Neves Freitas, Anderson Almeida-Silva & Andrew Nevins. 2022. Comparing Iconicity Trade-Offs in Cena and Libras during a Sign Language Production Task. Languages 7(2): 98. doi:10.3390/languages7020098
sources.note: Nothing; deals with handshape/movement complexity of classifier constructions under Brentari's Prosodic Model; no mention of stress, accent or prominence.

sources.citation: Almeida-Silva, Anderson & Andrew Nevins. 2020. Observações sobre a estrutura linguística da Cena: a língua de sinais emergente da Várzea Queimada (Piauí, Brasil). Revista Linguagem & Ensino 23(4): 1029-1053. doi:10.15210/rle.v23i4.18533
sources.note: Nothing. Section 'Nível fonético-fonológico' (p. 1043) says only that Cena 'emprega um ritmo mais abrupto e demanda o uso concomitante de mais articuladores do que a Libras', notes no manual alphabet, and that near-identical signs (same handshape, location, palm orientation) contrast via facial expression; syntax section (p. ~1047) says prosodic constituent boundaries need further study. No stress/accent statement (sign language).
